outcome: Numeric pain scale (NPS) levels at 2, 6, 12, and 24 hours postoperatively
cohort: 70 pregnant women of American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) class I-II undergoing cesarean section
finding: Ultrasound-guided transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block resulted in lower pain scores and longer duration of analgesia compared to local anesthetic infiltration at the wound site for postoperative pain management after cesarean section.
